title: FixNow - Customer Home (Editorial Express)
prompt:
Redesign ONLY the FixNow Customer Home screen from scratch as a premium, modern consumer discovery experience (Variant 1: "Editorial Commerce & Express Dispatch" inspired by Urban Company & modern delivery apps).

Key requirements:
1. Brand & Header:
- Use official FixNow logo: {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_53}} in a clean crisp size with location chip "Home • Flat 402, Green Glen Layout, Bellandur ▾" and right-aligned notification bell with unread badge and customer avatar profile.
- Warm, welcoming greeting: "Good morning, Aarav ✨" with tagline "Fast, verified home services at your doorstep".
- Prominent floating search bar: "Search 'switchboard repair', 'AC service'..." with voice search mic and filter button.

2. Live Active Booking Banner (Conditional/Dismissible card):
- Active Service Bar: "⚡ Technician En Route: Rahul K. arriving in 7 mins for Kitchen Tap Repair". One-tap "Track Live" button with pulsing emerald beacon and OTP reminder (PIN: 4821).

3. Emergency SOS Vortex Card:
- Distinct high-priority hazard card: "24/7 Emergency Dispatch" with glowing pulse border, 15-min arrival guarantee, and instant "Get Urgent Help" button for main pipe bursts & sparking panels.

4. Quick Filter Chips & Clean Service Category Grid:
- Filter chips: "⚡ Instant 15-Min", "⭐ Top Rated", "🛡️ Warranty Covered", "🏷️ Special Offers".
- 8-10 Curated Category cards with rich vector icons, clear starting prices ("From ₹199"), and live verified pro counts ("42 pros nearby").

5. FixAI Multimodal Diagnosis Hero Feature Banner:
- "FixAI Diagnostics — Can't explain the issue? Snap a photo or record audio for instant diagnosis & upfront quote". High-tech sleek pill button "Scan Problem Now".

6. Popular Services Horizontal Rail & Quick Bookings:
- "Trending in Bellandur": Modern high-contrast cards with ratings (4.9★), duration, transparent price tags, and "+ Add" buttons.
- "Book Again": Recent booking card with 1-tap re-dispatch.

7. Trust & Guarantee Assurance Footer:
- "FixNow Shield: 100% Background Checked Specialists • ₹0 Hidden Costs • 30-Day Workmanship Warranty".

8. Premium Bottom Navigation:
- 4 tabs: "Explore" (active emerald), "Bookings" (badge: 1), "Disputes/Help", "Profile".

Theme & Polish:
- Light theme with crisp #059669 emerald accents, slate typography (Plus Jakarta Sans), refined borders, subtle soft shadows, and smooth CSS micro-interactions (hover scales, pulse beacon, subtle entrance animation). No generic cards.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
### 🎨 Visual Identity: Safe
- **Palette & Typography:** An instantly credible on-demand service ecosystem pairing crisp utilitarian micro-data typography with trustworthy emerald greens and friendly 12-16px component contours.

## Brand & Style

This design system delivers an instantly credible, high-trust on-demand utility aesthetic built to withstand field conditions and high-stakes operational pressure. It serves three synchronized user archetypes: homeowners seeking rapid, transparent home repair; field technicians operating one-handed in varied light conditions; and dispatch administrators managing high-density real-time queues.

The visual style blends modern utilitarian minimalism with tactical precision. Clean canvas neutrals prioritize speed of parsing, while deep emerald tones communicate verified security, verified background checks, and resolution. Structural data layouts rely on micro-typographic indicators, tabbed currency formats, and high-visibility status pings to eliminate ambiguity across both bright outdoor service calls and desktop dispatch control centers.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model is anchored on an absolute 4px base increment, scaling cleanly between the technician field app, mobile web customer tracking, and the administrative dashboard:

- **Mobile Viewports (under 768px)**: 4-column layout with 16px (`margin`) outer boundaries and 16px (`gutter`) between vertical stack cards. Fixed bottoms are reserved for primary action bars (CTA height 52px minimum, 12px safe-area margins).
- **Tablet & Split-Screen Technicians (768px - 1024px)**: 8-column layout with 24px margins, allowing simultaneous viewing of map navigation and job acceptance sheets.
- **Admin Portal (1024px+)**: 12-column layout with 32px canvas margins and 24px gutters. Workspaces split between persistent navigation (260px fixed width), a dynamic filter sub-rail, and responsive data tables.
- **Vertical Hierarchy**: Internal card groups apply `space-sm` (8px), card-to-card relationships scale at `space-md` (16px), and disparate service categories breathe with `space-xl` (32px).

## Elevation & Depth

This design system avoids heavy shadows, instead using crisp outlines and ambient surface shifts for outdoor and fluorescent visibility:

- **Base Flat Surface (Level 0)**: Ground canvas rendered in `#F8FAFC`. Unhovered cards sit directly on this plane with a structural 1px border (`#E2E8F0`).
- **Interactive Container (Level 1)**: Floating modular cards and list items set on `#FFFFFF`, framed by `border: 1px solid #E2E8F0` and accompanied by a tinted contact shadow: `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Active / Drag State (Level 2)**: For provider order pop-ups and active tracking trays: `box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)`.
- **Modals, Hazard Alerts & Drawers (Level 3)**: SOS sheets, price confirmations, and admin slide-overs: `box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06)` combined with a 40% `#0F172A` backdrop scrim.

## Components

### Buttons & Action Controls
- **Primary CTA**: Background `#059669`, text `#FFFFFF`, 48px height on web, 54px on field screens. Hover: `#047857`, Active: `#0A5C36`. Radius: 12px.
- **Secondary Neutral**: Background `#0F172A`, text `#FFFFFF`, used for provider job acceptance or route locks.
- **Destructive / SOS**: Background `#DC2626`, text `#FFFFFF`. Applied with high-visibility icon pairing for field emergencies.
- **Ghost Action**: Transparent base, 1px border `#E2E8F0`, text `#0F172A`.

### Status Badges & Live Micro-Indicators
- **En Route / Online Ping**: Background `#ECFDF5`, text `#065F46`, border `#A7F3D0`. Includes a real-time pulsing 6px circle using `#10B981`.
- **In-Progress / Delayed**: Background `#FFFBEB`, text `#92400E`, border `#FDE68A`.
- **Hazard / SOS**: Background `#FEF2F2`, text `#991B1B`, border `#FECACA`.
- **Format**: Pill-shaped with `label-sm` typography and `padding: 4px 10px`.

### Modular Cards & Job Tiles
- **Technician Dispatch Card**: `#FFFFFF` background, 16px radius, bordered in `#E2E8F0`. Layout features customer location header, fixed tabular cost preview (`price-display`), and a primary dispatch trigger separated by a 1px internal rule (`#F1F5F9`).
- **Provider Earnings Summary**: High-contrast card with `#0F172A` background, emerald green trend readouts, and tabular numeric figures.

### Form Inputs & Selectors
- **Input Fields**: 48px height, 8px radius, border 1px solid `#CBD5E1`, background `#FFFFFF`. Focus ring: 2px offset in `#059669`. Label positioned above using `label-md` in `#0F172A`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios**: 20px hit targets with 4px inner rounding for checkboxes and full circular rounding for radio selections. Selected state: `#059669` fill with white indicator marks.

### Data Tables (Web Admin Portal)
- Row height: 56px with alternating hover effect (`#F8FAFC`).
- Header cells: `label-sm` uppercase, text color `#64748B`, with explicit numeric column alignments matching cell values.

- **Secondary (`#0F172A` Obsidian Slate)**: The dominant structural base for text hierarchy, system navigation bars, technical dashboard headers, and provider night-shift components.
- **Tertiary (`#F59E0B` Dispatch Amber)**: Reserved strictly for urgent transactional updates, in-progress timers, technician ETA alerts, and verified customer ratings.
- **System Hazard (`#DC2626` Crimson)**: A dedicated signal color applied exclusively to gas/electrical hazards, rapid dispatch cancellations, and technician SOS distress triggers.
- **Neutrals & Surfaces**: Built from `#FFFFFF` (elevated cards), `#F8FAFC` (foundation canvas), `#F1F5F9` (sunken wells, readouts, and track backgrounds), with `#E2E8F0` defining structural boundary lines.

## Typography

Typography establishes an immediate perception of security and functional control:

- **Display & Section Headers (`Plus Jakarta Sans`)**: Delivers friendly authority for customer service discovery, technician job titles, and dashboard milestone summaries. Its wide, open counters maintain readability at all sizes.
- **Operational Copy & Tabular Data (`Inter`)**: All body text, data matrices, line items, and addresses use Inter. Numeric values (costs, job IDs, countdown timers) mandate tabular numbers (`font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1`) to preserve vertical alignment during real-time dispatch changes and earnings calculations.
